name: file-corpus
purpose: Every ordinary object a reader must report identically on every host: names, identities, links, symlinks, sparse data, attributes, forks, flags, modes, ACLs, timestamps, Unicode comparison, HFS overflow extents, a signed app and a versioned framework.

versionNotes.lookups: Unicode comparison tables differ between APFS and HFS+ and between name policies; every outcome is recorded, none is asserted at capture.

steps.note: 512 KiB guards until fewer than 1.5 MiB remain free

fs.content: Signed resource preserved by image construction.
